ingoing_three.label: a shell of light
ingoing_three.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \tanh(v/v_0)$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.
caption: The plane of $v$ and $r$ ($\theta = 0$), with the ingoing rays the horizontal lines of constant $v$. The event horizon leaves the centre at $cv = -1.57\ell$, before the shell arrives, and lies on $r = \ell$ after it.

poincare_three.label: a shell of light
poincare_three.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = (1 + \tanh(v/v_0))/2\ell^2$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.
caption: The plane of $v$ and $z$ ($x = 0$), with the boundary at $z = 0$. Every ray runs at 45° before the shell. The event horizon is $z = \ell - cv/2$ before the shell and $z = \ell$ after it.

ingoing_four.label: a shell of light
ingoing_four.input: A thin shell of light of mass $M$ falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \tfrac{1}{2}M(1 + \tanh(v/v_0))$, $2GM/c^2 = 2\ell$, and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.
caption: The plane of $v$ and $r$ ($\theta = \pi/2$, $\phi = 0$), with the ingoing rays the horizontal lines of constant $v$. The event horizon leaves the centre at $cv = -1.57\ell$, before the shell arrives, and lies on $r = \ell$ after it.

flat_front.label: a shell of light
flat_front.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \tfrac{1}{2}\ell(1 + \tanh(v/v_0))$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.
caption: The plane of $v$ and $r$ ($x = y = 0$), with the ingoing rays the horizontal lines of constant $v$. The event horizon is $r = 2\ell^2/(2\ell - cv)$ before the shell and $r = \ell$ after it.
